suggested_experiment_name: NuSTAR Super Star Clusters (Quintuplet + Wd1 joint)
notes: Astrophysical bound from axions produced in super star clusters (Quintuplet, Wd1) converting to X-rays in Galactic magnetic fields, observed with NuSTAR. Joint 95% limit g_agamma < 3.6e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a < 5e-11 eV. Encoded as flat horizontal line over stated validity range.
